profileMessages.takeawayChanging: UV ranges from {minimumUv} to {peakUv} (average {averageUv}), with the highest forecast hour at {peakTime}.
profileMessages.steady: UV stays at {uv} across the {coveredDuration} with forecast data, so the average is also {averageUv}.
profileMessages.startEndAverage: Across the forecasted hours, UV starts at {startUv} and ends at {endUv}. The average is {averageUv}.
profileMessages.highest: Highest UV is {uv} for about {duration}, during {periods}.
profileMessages.lowest: Lowest UV is {uv} for about {duration}, during {periods}.
profileMessages.betweenSingle: In the remaining forecast hours, UV is {uv} for about {duration} in total.
profileMessages.betweenRange: In the remaining forecast hours, UV ranges from {minimumUv} to {maximumUv} for about {duration} in total.
profileMessages.elevatedAll: UV remains at 3 or higher for the full {coveredDuration} with forecast data.
profileMessages.elevatedPart: UV reaches 3 or higher for about {duration}.
profileMessages.elevatedSeparated: UV reaches 3 or higher in {count} separate stretches, totaling about {duration}.
profileMessages.veryHigh: UV reaches 8 or higher for about {duration}.
profileMessages.lowerUv: UV stays below 3 for about {duration} in total, during {periods}.

actionMessages.protection: At those times, cover exposed skin, wear a broad-brimmed hat and UV-protective sunglasses, and seek shade.
actionMessages.extraProtection: At those times, limit time in direct sun and prioritize shade. Keep the other protection steps in place.
actionMessages.sunscreenAtStart: UV is 3 or higher when this outing starts. Apply broad-spectrum SPF 30+ sunscreen generously to uncovered skin.
actionMessages.sunscreenLater: The first forecast UV 3+ period begins at {start}. Apply broad-spectrum SPF 30+ sunscreen generously to uncovered skin before then.
actionMessages.sunscreenReapplication: If you are still outdoors after applying sunscreen for this outing, reapply it at least every two hours. Reapply sooner after swimming, sweating, or towel drying, and follow the product label.
actionMessages.cloudyElevatedUv: Keep UV protection in place during {periods}, despite heavy cloud cover.
actionMessages.reflectiveConditions: Near snow, bright sand, or water, keep skin and eyes protected even in shade.

takeawayWindowMessages.below-3: From around {start} to around {end}, most people need no extra sun protection.
takeawayWindowMessages.3-to-8: From around {start} to around {end}, cover exposed skin, protect your eyes, seek shade, and use SPF 30+ sunscreen on uncovered skin.
takeawayWindowMessages.8-plus: From around {start} to around {end}, cover exposed skin, protect your eyes, use SPF 30+ sunscreen on uncovered skin, prioritize shade, and limit direct sun.

lowComplete: UV stays below 3 throughout this outing (average {averageUv}; highest {peakUv}).
For most people, no extra sun protection is needed during these hours.
lowPartial: UV stays below 3 for the {duration} with forecast data (average {averageUv}; highest {peakUv}).
For most people, no extra sun protection is needed during those hours.

messages.coverageIncomplete: Forecast available for {coveredDuration} of the planned {plannedDuration}. The remaining time has no forecast.
